dict.string: Fires a confetti cannon across the screen

This workflow fires a digital confetti cannon across your screen. Use when you need to celebrate a quick win!
Configuration Variables: - DURATION: How long the confetti stays on screen in seconds (Default: 5.0) - PARTICLE_COUNT: Density of the confetti (Default: 14) - THEME: Color palette to use. Options: standard, two bit, neon, pastel, and monochrome (Default: standard)
How long the confetti stays on screen (in seconds)
